items.question: How does the 30-day free trial work?
items.answer: Every plan comes with a 30-day free trial. No credit card required to start. You get full access to all features during the trial period.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your billing settings. Changes take effect immediately.

items.question: What happens when I add more team members?
items.answer: Each plan includes a set number of seats. If you need more seats, upgrade to a higher plan. All team members get full access to every AI agent.

items.question: How do you handle my data?
items.answer: We implement industry-standard security practices including HTTPS encryption, database-level data isolation between organizations, and row-level access controls. STRATUM is currently in alpha — please review our Privacy Policy for full details on our security practices and limitations.

items.question: What does 'Intelligence Over Execution' mean?
items.answer: STRATUM is a read-only intelligence platform. We help you think, plan, and strategize — but we never execute campaigns on your behalf. This means zero execution risk and full control over your marketing.
